providers.name: is-a.dev

eligibility.note: Personal sites and projects of developers, not businesses

steps: Fork the is-a-dev/register repository on GitHub
Add a file domains/{label}.json with your DNS records
Open a pull request and wait for a maintainer to approve it
providers.waitTime: Usually a few days (pull request review)

providers.name: js.org
steps: Host your project on GitHub Pages
Add a CNAME file containing {label}.js.org
Open a pull request adding {label} to cnames_active.js in js-org/js.org
providers.waitTime: Usually a few days (pull request review)

providers.name: eu.org

eligibility.note: Anyone; free for good, but you need two working DNS servers

steps: Create an account at nic.eu.org
Request {label}.eu.org and name two DNS servers that already answer for it
Wait for a volunteer to approve the request

providers.name: pp.ua

eligibility.note: Anyone with a mobile phone number for SMS confirmation

steps: Register {label}.pp.ua at a registrar that offers it for free
Confirm the registration by SMS within 14 days
providers.waitTime: Minutes, once the SMS is confirmed

providers.name: DigitalPlat (dpdns.org)
steps: Create a DigitalPlat FreeDomain account and complete verification
Register {label}.dpdns.org and point it to your DNS provider (for example Cloudflare)

providers.name: Cloudflare Pages

eligibility.note: Static sites and front-end apps hosted on Cloudflare Pages

steps: Create a Cloudflare Pages project named {label}
Deploy your site

providers.name: Vercel

eligibility.note: Any web app; the free Hobby plan is for non-commercial use

steps: Create a Vercel project named {label}
Deploy your site

providers.name: Netlify

eligibility.note: Static sites and front-end apps hosted on Netlify

steps: Create a Netlify site
Rename it to {label} in the site settings

providers.name: GitHub Pages

eligibility.note: The name must be your GitHub username or organisation; GitHub Pages is not meant for commercial sites

steps: Create a GitHub account or organisation named {label}
Create a repository called {label}.github.io and publish your site from it
